about_the_game:
Lead your babies, protect your flock, and claim the longest line!

Line Up! is a chaotic, couch multiplayer game where you take on the role of a caring Mama (or Papa) trying to guide your adorable—but easily confused—babies through a bustling world. Other critters are doing the same, and they won’t hesitate to defend their little ones with everything they’ve got!

Master the art of herding, outsmart your rivals, and navigate tricky crowds to create the longest line of babies in the game. But beware: every bump, distraction, or mischievous opponent can send your little ones scattering!

Features:

  • Couch multiplayer: Compete with friends and family in frantic, fun-packed matches.

  • Cute and cunning: Lead your babies while avoiding rival critters who will fiercely defend their own.

  • Strategic herding: Timing, positioning, and clever tactics matter when guiding your flock.

  • Endless replayability: Each match is unique, with randomized crowds and unpredictable opponents.

  • Adorable visuals: Colorful, charming art style makes every round a joy to watch.

Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate Mama and lead the longest line? Gather your flock and find out in Line Up!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04, SteamOS 3.0, or equivalent (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 550 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7750 / Intel HD Graphics 530
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL compatible
  • VR Support: n/a
  • Additional Notes: Gamepads recommended for local multiplayer
